exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb + nasai".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
Verb なさい (〜nasai)
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb なさい (〜nasai) matches "Verb + nasai".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb なさい (〜nasai).
exercises.explanation: Used to give direct orders or instructions, often by superiors.
